name: Multicultural Faire
description: The PTA is eager and excited to have different cultures from around the world at our Annual Multicultural Faire! We would love to see you there, hosting a Booth or do a Performance showcasing your culture. If you or someone you know, would like to perform for Los Alamitos MCF, please reach out to us. It's a great opportunity for our kids to get involved, learn, and even present what they've prepared.

name: Yearbook Purchase Deadline
description: If you haven't purchased the yearbook, please purchase it before April 20th. No yearbooks will be sold once they are distributed.

name: Green Team Interest Survey
description: Green Team will be starting soon. Fill out the interest survey to let the PTA know if your student is interested in joining. The focus will be on learning how to take care of the environment.

name: Variety Show
description: Don't miss the Variety Show! Come watch your friends sing, dance, act and more. The show is on Friday, March 20th at 4pm.

name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos! The fair will be held March 24-26 from 8:30am-3:00pm in the library. There will be a special Family Night on March 24 from 5:00-7:00pm. Volunteers are needed throughout the week.

name: Spring Pictures
description: Spring Picture Day is on March 26th. Students can wear free dress.

name: Dress Like Your Favorite Book Character
description: Dress Like Your Favorite Book Character Spirit Day is on March 27th.

name: Open House
description: Open House is on March 31st from 5:00-6:00pm. Bring your child to show you what they have been working on.

name: K/3 Buddy Egg Hunt
description: Kindergarten and 3rd grade classes will have a Spring Egg Hunt together. Parents are asked to donate 16 plastic eggs filled with non-candy items like stickers, erasers, or small toys.

name: ELA Testing
description: 3rd-5th grade students will take the ELA - CAT/PT Testing from April 20-24.

name: Math Testing
description: 3rd-5th grade students will take the Math CAT/PT Testing from April 27 - May 1.

name: Art Vista Show
description: The PTA Art Vista Show is on May 5th.

name: Gold Rush
description: The 4th grade Gold Rush event is on May 8th.

name: Colonial Day
description: The 5th grade Colonial Day event is on May 15th.

name: Memorial Day
description: No school on Memorial Day.

name: Last Day of School
description: Last day of school, Aloha Day spirit day. Minimum day, dismissal at 12:06pm.

name: PTA Board Nominations
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! If you're interested in getting involved, please email us or connect with any of our current board members. The current slate for the 2026-2027 school year will be voted on at our next general meeting on April 27th.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: Castillero Athletic Booster Club
description: Attention 5th grade parents! Looking to get involved at Castillero? Consider joining the Castillero Athletic Booster Club (CABC) Board! The time commitment is very manageable and it is a great way to get involved at Castillero!

name: CMBC Fundraiser - See's Candies
description: Support Our CMBC Program – Sweeten Easter & Mother's Day! We've partnered with See's Candies once again to bring you delicious, high-quality chocolates just in time for Easter and Mother's Day. All sales from this storefront will support instruments, sheet music, and performance opportunities for our students—and we'd love your support!

name: Family Fun Night - The Kebab Shop
description: Show this flyer when ordering in store or use code FUNDRAISER for online orders and 25% of sales will go the PTA!
location: The Kebab Shop- 5110 Cherry Ave Ste 30
